confidence_notes: July food prices are approximated from [crowdsourced restaurant data](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/San-Sebastian) and a [local drinks guide](https://seekspain.com/the-ultimate-guide-to-san-sebastian-nightlife-bars-clubs-live-music/). Cocktail and wine estimates are roughly 3.8 and 1.3 times the draft-beer price, respectively. Accommodation figures are holistic estimates; July prices can vary widely by date and location.
comparable_city_reasoning: Accommodation estimates use coastal Basque and northern Spanish cities as a regional basis, adjusted for San Sebastian's strong summer tourism demand.
